title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Carrying Out Pilot Work on Community Corrections
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Justice

Notice on Carrying Out the Pilot Work of Community Correction

Sifa Fa [2003] No. 12

Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, and the Justice Bureau:

Community correction is a method of executing criminal punishment as opposed to incarceration correction. It refers to the non-custodial penal execution activity in which offenders who meet the conditions for community correction are placed in the community, and specialized state organs, with the assistance of relevant social groups, non-governmental organizations, and social volunteers, correct their criminal psychology and behavioral vices within the period determined by the judgment, ruling, or decision, and promote their smooth return to society. Community correction is a work of targeted management, education, and reform in the community for offenders whose crimes are relatively minor, whose subjective malignancy is relatively small, and whose social harm is not significant, or for offenders who, after supervision and reform, have genuinely shown repentance and will not endanger society again, by actively utilizing various social resources and integrating various social forces. It is a development trend of the penal system in countries around the world. To meet the requirements of the political, economic, social, and cultural development of our country, it is necessary to carry out pilot work in community correction and actively explore the reform of the penal execution system.

I. Raise Awareness, Change Concepts, and Fully Understand the Significance of Carrying Out the Pilot Work of Community Correction

The pilot work of community correction is of great significance. First, it is conducive to exploring the establishment of a socialist penal system with Chinese characteristics, actively promoting the construction of socialist democracy and the legal system, fully reflecting the superiority of our socialist system and the requirements of human civilization and progress, and serving the construction of socialist political civilization and the comprehensive construction of a moderately prosperous society. Second, it is conducive to implementing targeted socialized correction for those offenders who do not need or are not suitable for incarceration or continued incarceration, making full use of the strength of all sectors of society, improving the quality of education and reform, maximizing the transformation of negative factors into positive factors, and maintaining social stability. Third, it is conducive to the rational allocation of penal execution resources, making incarceration correction and community correction complement each other, enhancing the effectiveness of punishment, and reducing the cost of penal execution.

In recent years, some localities, under the leadership of local party committees and governments, have carried out some pilot work on community correction, summarizing and accumulating some good experiences and practices, with positive social results.

Judicial organs at all levels, procuratorial organs, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs must further unify their thinking and attach great importance to the pilot work of community correction. They must, based on the new situations and new requirements of our country's social development, constantly summarize our experience in fighting criminal offenses, learn from the beneficial practices of other countries in the field of criminal justice, emancipate the mind, update concepts, insist on severely punishing serious criminal offenders according to law, actively explore community correction for offenders with minor crimes, promote the reform of the penal execution system with Chinese characteristics, fundamentally improve the quality of education and reform of offenders, prevent and reduce recidivism, and achieve the long-term stability of the country.

The pilot work of community correction should be carried out actively and steadily. In the pilot work, the judicial, procuratorial, public security, and judicial administrative departments must not only perform their duties in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, the Prison Law, and other relevant laws of our country, but also keep pace with the times, actively explore, and through the pilot work, continuously expand the scope of application of community correction, improve the organizational system of community correction, perfect the work measures of community correction, and promote the reform of the penal execution system. While deepening the pilot and summarizing experiences, we should actively promote the legislation of community correction and achieve the standardized development of community correction work.

II. Scope of Application and Tasks of Community Correction

(1) Scope of Application of Community Correction

According to the provisions of the current laws of our country, the scope of application of community correction mainly includes the following five types of offenders:

1. Those sentenced to public surveillance (管制).
2. Those who are granted probation (缓刑).
3. Those who are temporarily serving their sentences outside prison (监外执行), specifically including:
   (1) Those with serious diseases needing medical parole (保外就医);
   (2) Pregnant women or women who are breastfeeding their own infants;
   (3) Those who cannot take care of themselves and whose temporary service of sentence outside prison would not endanger society.
4. Those who are granted parole (假释) by ruling.
5. Those who are deprived of political rights and are serving their sentences in the community.

Under the above conditions, for minor offenders, elderly, sick, or disabled offenders with minor subjective malignancy, and first-time offenders or negligent offenders with minor crimes, the above non-custodial measures should be applied as key targets, and community correction should be implemented.

(2) Tasks of Community Correction

1. In accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, and other relevant laws, regulations, and rules of our country, strengthen the management and supervision of persons serving sentences in the community to ensure the smooth implementation of the punishment.
2. Through various forms, strengthen ideological education, legal education, and education on social morality for persons serving sentences in the community, correct their unhealthy psychology and behavior, so that they repent and reform, abandon evil and do good, and become law-abiding citizens.
3. Help persons serving sentences in the community solve difficulties and problems encountered in employment, life, legal matters, psychology, etc., to facilitate their smooth adaptation to social life.

In the pilot work, localities should, according to the needs of the community correction work tasks, further explore and innovate the specific content, methods, work processes, and work systems of community correction, and strive to improve the quality of education and reform.

III. Division of Responsibilities, Close Cooperation, and Joint Efforts to Do a Good Job in the Pilot Work of Community Correction

Carrying out the community correction pilot is a highly comprehensive work. Relevant departments must perform their respective duties according to law, cooperate with and support each other, and ensure the smooth progress of the pilot work.

The People's Courts must strictly and accurately apply criminal laws and criminal judicial interpretations, and fully use non-custodial penalty measures and penal execution measures such as commutation of sentence and parole that encourage offenders to reform and start anew according to law. When imposing non-custodial penalties, commutation of sentence, or parole, the opinions of relevant community correction organizations may be solicited, and after the judgment or pronouncement, copies of the judgment or ruling shall be sent to the relevant community correction organizations.

The People's Procuratorates must strengthen legal supervision, improve the supervision procedures for penal execution, and ensure that community correction work is carried out according to law and fairly.

The Judicial Administrative Organs must take the lead in organizing relevant units and community grassroots organizations to carry out the pilot work of community correction, jointly with the public security organs to do a good job in supervising and inspecting persons serving sentences in the community, and organize and coordinate the education, reform, and assistance work for persons serving sentences in the community. The judicial offices of sub-districts and townships shall specifically undertake the daily management of community correction. The prison administration organs must accurately apply the measures for temporary service of sentence outside prison according to law, promptly submit to the People's Court for a ruling on parole for those who meet the conditions for parole, and actively assist the work of community correction organizations.

The Public Security Organs must cooperate with the judicial administrative organs to strengthen the supervision and inspection of persons serving sentences in the community according to law, and perform relevant legal procedures according to law. For persons serving sentences in the community who violate supervision and inspection regulations, necessary measures shall be taken according to the specific circumstances and law; for persons serving sentences in the community who commit new crimes, they shall be dealt with promptly according to law.

IV. Strengthen Leadership to Ensure the Smooth Progress of the Pilot Work

The pilot work of community correction should be carried out in communities with relatively good grassroots work, summarizing and accumulating experiences, continuously expanding the pilot, and gradually promoting it. After research, Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shandong provinces (municipalities) are designated as pilot provinces (municipalities) for community correction work.

The pilot provinces (municipalities) should, on the basis of full investigation and research, formulate specific plans for the pilot according to the requirements of this Notice and in light of local conditions. They should select places with the necessary conditions, organize social forces from all sides, strengthen team building, establish work systems, carry out positive publicity, and ensure that the pilot work is implemented. The pilot work should mainly be carried out in urban communities, and in rural townships where conditions permit, pilot work may also be carried out according to the situation. We must carefully study and solve the new situations and new problems that arise during the pilot work, continuously reform and improve the pilot plan, and lay a solid foundation for the comprehensive development of community correction work.

The pilot work shall be carried out under the unified leadership of Party committees and governments at all levels. All relevant departments must actively participate and cooperate vigorously, effectively solve the practical difficulties and major problems in the pilot work, so that the pilot work of community correction can proceed smoothly. We must give full play to the role of grassroots self-governing mass organizations, social groups, and social volunteers, actively participate in and assist the pilot work of community correction. On the basis of the experience gained from the pilot work, we should promote legislation on community correction and provide legal guarantees for reforming and perfecting the penal execution system with Chinese characteristics.

July 10, 2003
